**What changes, and why?**


**How did you check it?** Which of the three suites did you run, and did you
add a test that fails without your change?


**Does this change a file the website serves?** Then add a line to
`assets/update-note.txt` saying what a visitor will notice, or a single `-` if
they will not notice anything. The deploy stops without it. See CONTRIBUTING.md
for the other three rules that fail silently.
